name: nginx-multisite
description: Provides Nginx web hosting for three named sites with static content, HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects, self-signed TLS certificates, security headers, rate limits, compression, and host security hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis as local caching services, including Redis authentication, runtime and log directory handling, configuration cleanup, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a Python FastAPI tutorial application from GitHub, provisions its virtual environment and dependencies, initializes PostgreSQL and application credentials, and manages a systemd service running Uvicorn.
